This '''alien race''' were tall, muscular beings with orange skin, three-fingered hands, five green eyes, and a large, triangular head with snakelike tendrils in place of [[Hair/Legends|hair]]. Their [[Stauz Czycz's species homeworld|homeworld]] was razed by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]]. [[Stauz Czycz]] was a member of this [[Species/Legends|species]].
